thread:
lina: Overcast dedicated rollout proposed for Thu 03/26 22:00 UTC. Need final pin, KMS > handoff confirmation, and ops + infra sign-off. Can we lock the window?
jen: Heads up — infra has patch maintenance ending 22:15 UTC. Can we shift to 22:30 to be safe? :thinking_face: 
ops-ryan: We can do 22:30. KMS rotation is not scheduled that night on our side. Need PM to confirm no customer cron jobs at that time.
sam: I'll take smoke tests and watch P90/P95 during the canary. Plan: run smoke + 15m observation, then shift traffic 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m steps.
jen: I pinned the runtime image and model variant to avoid drift: `dedicated/overcast:v2.14.3` and `overcast-model-q4-2026-pt` pinned in release config. Updated runbook with rollback steps: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/overcast-rollout (added entry for quick rollback to v2.14.2).
ops-ryan: Confirmed KMS, and KMS key will stay static. Ensure deploy has `--kms-verify` flag.
lina: Approved if the following are in place: 1) deploy pin locked 2) runbook link in release notes 3) smoke + 15m observation with alert gates.
jen: Done on 1/2/3. Also added alert gates: >5% error rate increase in 10m OR >200ms P95 increase triggers immediate pause and rollback.
deploybot: [automated] pin action: `lock_release` executed by @jen. Artifact `dedicated/overcast:v2.14.3` locked at 1719982468. Canary policy applied: slices [3,7] capacity=20%.
sam: Canary started — initial health: all checks green, avg latency 98ms. Streaming snippet: ```SERVICE health: OK
errors: 0
latency_p95: 102ms```
jen: Nice. Will monitor logs for any tokenization regressions; added prompt-suite smoke tests to CI trigger.
lina: LGTM from PM — please post final release notes after full roll. I will email customer ops a heads up at 22:00 UTC.
ops-ryan: If anything looks off I will trigger backout script: `./scripts/rollback-overcast.sh --target v2.14.2` and open incident channel.
deploybot: [automated] canary update: after 12m, slices stable, 0 errors, avg latency change +3ms. Proceeding to 50% traffic in 2m.
sam: 50% shift done. Monitoring.
jen: Noting we might need to throttle batching if token throughput spikes — will be ready to adjust config `batch.max_tokens=1024` if p99 climbs.
lina: Thanks team — final signs look good. I'll close the loop with a short customer note and attach the release notes. :thumbsup:
notes: release notes will be added to customer email post-rollout
